manual_dispatch_timebox_policy.purpose: keep ordinary user-triggered reports finite; deep research can continue only as a separately requested workflow
manual_dispatch_timebox_policy.terms_note: ordinary_dispatch 是普通手动报告；hard_stop 是本轮必须收口的上限，不代表目标停止学习

realtime_price_dynamic_analysis_gate.purpose: certify real-time or near-real-time prices before current actions, trigger deeper dynamic analysis when data is insufficient, and arbitrate recommendations by short-term and long-term goals

tactical_drawdown_sentinel_gate.purpose: force every manual US equity report to inspect existing tactical holdings for cost-basis drawdown, recent-high drawdown, relative underperformance, volume breakdown, and news/filing risks before recommending new trades

pre_entry_downside_and_capital_risk_gate.purpose: estimate adverse path, event gap, financing, dilution, valuation and target-before-stop risk before a US tactical recommendation can become a main action

market_risk_intuition_panel.purpose: translate market data into front-loaded risk warnings and intuitive market-state explanations before technical recommendations

macro_micro_sufficiency_gate.purpose: prevent daily manual action reports from being generated when only shallow price data is available and macro/micro coverage is insufficient

decision_rules.status_only: report state and triggers only; no new buy or sell amounts
decision_rules.no_current_action_due_to_missing_latest_: current price, liquidity, volume or cash rail is missing and no current action prices may be issued

macro_micro_sufficiency_gate.user_stated_premarket_price_rule: may be used as scenario input but cannot alone justify main-size chase; label as user_stated_premarket_price until independently verified
macro_micro_sufficiency_gate.if_7d_30d_or_onchain_missing_but_24h_pri: max action action_report_allowed and reduce size or use limit orders; full_near_term_deploy blocked

progressive_learning_confidence_policy.purpose: allow the system to start with 60%-79% reviewable learning recommendations and improve toward 80%+ through resolved outcomes, without weakening execute_now gates

success_semantics.goal_mechanism_ready: fresh data, report, recommendation records, paper review calendar, outcome review, attribution and next-evidence backlog are all functioning
success_semantics.goal_complete: actual financial target is achieved and tactical live readiness is proven; never inferred from a single iteration
success_semantics.current_iteration_acceptance: mechanism readiness and progressive learning loop are sufficient; financial target proof remains future evidence

stage_acceptance_and_compounding_policy.purpose: separate temporary system-stage completion from final financial goal completion, using audited report readiness plus a 60% paper/history learning floor

stage_completion_semantics.stage_system_complete: audited reports, structured recommendation records, paper/history learning evidence, and next-iteration loop are functioning
stage_completion_semantics.temporarily_complete: current build milestone can be considered complete, while the goal stays active for future market dispatches
stage_completion_semantics.goal_complete: real portfolio has achieved the 5y/10y 10x objective; never inferred from stage completion

compounding_reference.floor_semantics: These are minimum compounding floors, not ceilings. Recommendations should seek opportunities above the relevant floor while avoiding drawdowns that break compounding.
compounding_reference.note: Monthly DCA changes exact account math, but each dispatch should improve positive expected value, avoid large drawdowns, record outcomes, and keep compounding.

progressive_learning_iteration_audit.purpose: quantify whether each dispatch is improving the evidence loop from 60% reviewable samples toward 80%+ validated decisions

schema_baseline_gate.purpose: confirm whether SQL files exist and identify the authoritative schema/ledger baseline for each manual dispatch

active_goal_execution_matrix.purpose: bind the active user goal to concrete dispatch requirements, evidence gaps, action limits, and next triggers

passive_runtime_policy.plain_language_boundary: active_data_collection_inside_a_user_triggered_dispatch_only; no background trading, no live orders, no auto transfer

manual_dispatch_runner.strict_fresh_default_behavior: outside smoke mode, manual_dispatch_run.py passes --require-fresh-market-intelligence by default; degraded readable reports require explicit opt-out and still block execute_now
manual_dispatch_runner.audit_failure_propagation: manual_dispatch_run.py marks the whole dispatch report_audit_failed when report_integrity_audit or objective_coverage_audit fails, so failed reports cannot look successful at the top level

paper_validation_pulse.purpose: each manual dispatch first checks whether paper samples are actually due; only due_now samples trigger a single timeboxed paper validation pulse, while not-yet-due samples produce a status report and stop

learning_review_calendar.purpose: each manual dispatch shows the next paper/recommendation reviews and why execute_now remains blocked until enough outcomes are resolved

next_dispatch_readiness.purpose: before the next manual run, show whether the system can run a formal report, what blocks execute_now, and which review or evidence task comes first

next_goal_execution_queue.purpose: turn readiness, learning reviews, and evidence closure items into a short next-step queue for the following manual dispatch

current_goal_status_report.purpose: turn closeout readiness and next-step queue into a concise user-facing status page instead of continuing long loops

next_manual_dispatch_execution_plan.purpose: after readiness and queue, generate a concise next manual-dispatch plan so the next run knows what to refresh, what to review, and when to stop

portfolio_evidence_request_report.purpose: turn portfolio evidence gaps into a user-facing checklist for lcETH cost/redeem terms, US cash rail, ADA/SOL lots, and crypto cash/open orders

current_turn_closeout_gate.purpose: prevent ordinary passive manual-dispatch turns from running indefinitely after the mechanism is ready and no due-now review exists

investment_decision_validity.purpose: separate a script status=ok from a formal investment report and from execute_now eligibility

smoke_mode.purpose: verify runner wiring without mutating recommendation ledger

objective_traceability_gate.purpose: prove every user objective is tied to a report panel, script evidence, and downgrade rule instead of being treated as a vague aspiration

strategy_iteration_backlog_gate.purpose: keep searching for better strategies while forcing every new idea through research, paper validation, recommendation calibration, and manual confirmation

asset_goal_contribution_panel.notes: This panel converts holdings, staking APY, lock/unlock data, and goal gaps into asset-level DCA implications. It must not by itself authorize execute_now.

portfolio_evidence_gap_panel.notes: This panel converts missing lcETH lots/redemption terms, partial ADA/SOL lots, US broker cash/buying power and crypto cash-floor issues into an import checklist. It must not invent cost basis or treat user-stated broker cash as verified.

timeboxed_closeout.purpose: prevent one manual dispatch from turning into an open-ended deep research run

social_news_agent.reason: social/news improves discovery and risk alerts but cannot be the sole basis for a real trade

timeboxed_closeout.required_report_note: state which roles returned, which roles timed out, why the report is degraded, and what short follow-up task would repair the gap

quality_gate_requirements.notes: Evidence quality is separate from action readiness. A role may be evidence-verified while still blocking execute_now because it found real cost, cash, paper-validation, double-80, or human-confirmation blockers.

deployable_tactical_position_policy.current_example_only: SOXL may be selected today, but it is not a permanent benchmark or funding source

goal_linked_timeboxed_trade_plan.purpose: force US tactical advice to connect the user's monthly tactical return goal to concrete one-week, two-week, and monthly decision nodes

target_achievement_gate.probability_not_readiness_note: forecast_probability_pct is true target achievement probability; execution_readiness_score is points, not probability

concentrated_long_term_dca_gate.purpose: keep long-term DCA concentrated in a few high-quality assets and require every new candidate to beat adding to an existing underweight holding

dca_investment_intensity_panel.purpose: make the report explicitly answer whether current crypto cash should be deployed normally, accelerated, fully deployed, or held for a trigger

long_horizon_low_value_acceleration_gate.purpose: when crypto is in a long-term low-value zone, compare waiting for a pullback against early exposure, time-in-market and staking compounding; waiting must prove it is better than at least a first tranche
long_horizon_low_value_acceleration_gate.dynamic_buy_strategy_rule: size and timing can shift between near-price entry, better-pullback limit order and front-loaded DCA according to long-term value zone, thesis quality, staking activation delay, liquidity and current portfolio underweight status

staking_opportunity_cost_model.rule: if expected_pullback_advantage_pct is less than required_pullback_to_wait_pct, prefer near_price_entry or accelerated_dca; for stakeable assets, waiting must also compensate delayed staking activation

low_value_entry_panel.purpose: force every DCA report to decide whether long-term low-value conditions justify earlier entry, front-loaded DCA, or waiting with a clear trigger
low_value_entry_panel.cash_idle_default: cash is a temporary opportunity bucket, not a long-term default, when verified long-term low-value stakeable assets are underweight

front_load_decision_matrix.plain_language_rule: 早买不是追高；只有在长期低位和质押/长期暴露收益能补偿等待风险时，才把未来一小部分DCA提前。

report_requirements: state that waiting is not the default when verified long-term low-value stakeable assets are underweight
state why early staking/time-in-market is better or worse than waiting
state whether staking activation delay makes waiting more expensive
state whether this run should front-load 0, 0.25, 0.5, or 1.0 month of future DCA for verified long-term low-value assets
show the near-term total budget after front-loading, while preserving the stablecoin opportunity bucket
keep DCA action to at most two tranches
show whether accelerated DCA improves 5y/10y 10x probability
show whether waiting creates time-cost risk from missed staking compounding or missed long-term recovery
show what would invalidate the acceleration
